**Finding submitted: `missing` (medium severity, warranty).**

**What the document says.** Article VIX consists solely of a disclaimer. The Licensed Technology is provided "AS IS" without warranty of any kind; all express and implied warranties — merchantability, non-infringement, fitness for particular purpose, completeness, use, accuracy and title — are disclaimed; and Licensor affirmatively refuses to warrant that the technology is error-free, that it will meet Licensee's requirements, that operation will be uninterrupted or secure, or that nonconformities to the Documentation "CAN OR WILL BE CORRECTED."

**Why it's a deviation.** A full-document search for "warrant" confirms there is no affirmative Licensor performance or conformance warranty anywhere — the only warranty language either runs against our client (p0049, p0129) or is mutual boilerplate about consulting counsel (p0159). Combined with the liability exclusion at p0130 (which expressly covers breach of express or implied warranty), our client has no contractual recourse if the platform fails to perform as documented. That is precisely the playbook walk-away position.

**The redline (validated ok:true).**
- **p0110** — narrow the disclaimer with a carve-out so it cannot swallow the new warranty: "EXCEPT FOR THE EXPRESS WARRANTIES SET FORTH BELOW IN THIS ARTICLE VIX, THE LICENSED TECHNOLOGY IS PROVIDED ON AN 'AS IS' BASIS…"
- **After p0116** — insert an express warranty: workmanlike performance of services, 12-month conformance of the Licensed Software to the Documentation (using the existing defined terms at p0006 and p0017), compliance with applicable laws, and no malicious code — with a repair/replace/re-perform/refund remedy at Licensor's option.

The comment flags the 90-day/30-day fallback so the negotiation has somewhere to land if 12 months is resisted.
